brief.text: I am planning to start social media accounts with the persona of a Singaporean moving to Shanghai, vlog style. Look for such videos and analyse hooks and styles.
brief.audience: Singaporeans and Southeast Asians considering or starting a move to mainland China
brief.persona: A Singaporean in their late twenties who has just moved to Shanghai, filming daily life, admin hurdles and cultural contrasts in a candid vlog voice mixing English and Mandarin.
